title: The Room Behind the Wall
author: Alexandre Dias
excerpt: He heard it the first time on a Tuesday evening in late October. Alejandro was standing at his kitchen sink, washing the plate from his dinner, when he heard a small dry cough. It came from behind the wall to his right. He put his hand on the wall. It was warm — in the specific way of a wall that has, on its other side, been in contact with something warm.

chapters.title: The Cough
chapters.body:
He heard it the first time on a Tuesday evening in late October.

Alejandro Vega was forty-one, and he had, in the summer of that year, bought a small careful flat in a small careful neighborhood of Barcelona — a small careful ground-floor flat with a small careful patio at the back and a small careful galley kitchen and one small careful bedroom, which he had, in the specific small careful way of a small careful man in the middle of his small careful life, decided he wanted for himself. He had, over the small careful several months since taking possession, been slowly making the small careful place his own. He had painted the small careful sitting room a small careful pale blue. He had, at a small careful shop on Carrer d'Aribau, chosen a small careful sofa and a small careful table and two small careful chairs. He had put his small careful books on the small careful shelves. He had, in the small careful way, been happy in it.

He had, on that Tuesday evening in October, been standing at his small careful kitchen sink, washing the small careful plate and the small careful glass from his small careful dinner, when he had heard the small careful sound.

It had come from behind the small careful wall to his right.

The small careful wall to his right was the small careful wall between his small careful kitchen and his small careful bathroom. He had, on the small careful hearing, thought that the small careful sound had come from the small careful bathroom — that a small careful pipe, or the small careful cistern of the small careful toilet, had made a small careful noise of a small careful kind he had not, in the small careful three months, heard it make before.

chapters.title: The Hole
chapters.body:
He had, on the following morning, examined the small careful wall.

The first was that he had, in the specific small careful way of a small careful tired man, imagined the small careful sounds. Over the small careful section of the small careful wall to the small careful left of that, the small careful wall had produced the small careful ordinary dull sound of solid brick. He had, throughout the small careful three months, not been aware of this small careful space. —

He had, in the small careful call, told the small careful contractor only that he had a small careful section of a small careful wall that appeared to be small careful hollow, and that he wanted to know what was in it.

The small careful contractor had, in the specific small careful way, come the following morning. He had been a small careful man of perhaps fifty, named Josep. He had brought a small careful bag of small careful tools. He had, in the small careful kitchen, tapped the small careful wall in the specific small careful way Alejandro had done, and had, at the small careful tap, made a small careful face.

He had said: *there is, in the specific small careful way, a small careful cavity.*

Alejandro had said: *yes.*

Josep had said: *is there — is there any small careful record of it in the small careful building plans?*

Alejandro had said: *no.*

Josep had said, in the specific small careful way: *strange.*

He had, in the specific small careful way, drilled a small careful hole of about a small careful centimeter in diameter through the small careful wall, at approximately the small careful height of his small careful eye.

He had, in the specific small careful way, taken from his small careful bag a small careful small torch.

He had held the small careful torch to the small careful hole. He had, in the specific small careful way, put his small careful eye to the small careful hole.

He had, for a small careful long moment, looked.

He had, at last, in the specific small careful way, stepped back from the small careful wall.

He had, on his small careful face, an expression Alejandro had not, at any point in the small careful morning, seen him have.

He had said, in a small careful quiet voice: *there is — there is a small careful room.*

Alejandro had said: *a room.*

Josep had said: *a small careful room. Perhaps a small careful meter and a half wide. Perhaps two small careful meters deep. Perhaps the small careful height of a small careful person.*

Alejandro had said: *and — and inside it.*

Josep had said, quietly: *there is a small careful person.*

—

Alejandro had, at the small careful hole in the small careful wall, looked.

He had, on the small careful looking, seen exactly what Josep had described.

The small careful room had been perhaps a small careful meter and a half in width, and perhaps two small careful meters in depth. It had had no small careful visible door on any of its small careful walls. It had had no small careful window. It had, in the specific small careful way, been dimly lit — by what small careful source of light he could not, from the small careful hole, quite determine.

In the small careful room had been a small careful man.

The small careful man had been perhaps forty. He had been standing in the small careful centre of the small careful room. He had been wearing, so far as Alejandro could see through the small careful hole, a small careful dark shirt and small careful dark trousers. He had, in the specific small careful way, been facing the small careful wall through which Alejandro was looking.

He had been looking at Alejandro.

Alejandro had, at the small careful hole, made a small careful sound.

The small careful man had, at the small careful other side of the small careful hole, done something Alejandro had not, in the specific small careful way, expected.

He had, in the specific small careful way, waved.

Not in any small careful expansive way. In the specific small careful way of a small careful man giving a small careful acknowledging small careful wave to a small careful person he had, in the specific small careful way, been waiting for.

Alejandro had, at the small careful hole, been unable to move.

He had, at last, in the specific small careful way, said, into the small careful hole: *hello.*

The small careful man on the small careful other side had said, in a small careful voice that had come clearly through the small careful hole: *hello, Alejandro.*

chapters.title: Said Aloud
chapters.body:
Josep had, in the specific small careful way, been asked to leave.

Alejandro had done this in the specific small careful way of a man who had, over the small careful last several minutes, understood that whatever was in the small careful room was, in the specific small careful way, not a small careful matter for a small careful contractor. He had paid Josep for the small careful morning's work. He had, in the specific small careful way, apologized for the small careful trouble. He had said that he would, in the specific small careful way, deal with the small careful cavity himself.

Josep had, at the small careful door, looked at Alejandro for a small careful long moment.

Josep had said: *are you — are you certain, señor?*

Alejandro had said: *yes.*

Josep had said, quietly: *señor. If you would like — if you would like a small careful referral to a small careful priest. My cousin's wife's brother is at the small careful parish at Santa Anna. He has, in his small careful work, seen certain small careful things.*

Alejandro had said: *thank you. I will consider it.*

Josep had, at the small careful door, in the specific small careful way, left.

Alejandro had, alone in his small careful flat, gone back into the small careful kitchen.

He had, at the small careful hole, put his small careful eye against it again.

The small careful man had, on the small careful other side, been in exactly the small careful position he had been in when Alejandro had, in the specific small careful way, last looked.

Alejandro had said, quietly, into the small careful hole: *who are you.*

The small careful man had said, in his small careful voice: *I am the small careful person you have been carrying with you since you were nine years old.*

Alejandro had, at the small careful hole, been quiet for a very long moment.

He had said, at last, more quietly: *what does that mean.*

The small careful man had said: *do you remember, Alejandro, the small careful summer at your grandmother's small careful house in Málaga. The summer when you were nine. The summer when your small careful cousin Andrés died.*

Alejandro had, at the small careful hole, felt a specific small careful chill pass through him.

He had said: *yes.*

The small careful man had said: *you were in the small careful garden. You and Andrés. He had, in the specific small careful way, been climbing the small careful wall at the small careful back of the small careful garden. You had told him — you had told him not to. You had, in the specific small careful way of a small careful nine-year-old cousin, been a small careful little jealous of him. You had, in the specific small careful way, wanted to be the small careful one climbing the small careful wall. But you had, in the specific small careful way, been a small careful little afraid of it.*

*And he had fallen.*

Alejandro had said, very quietly: *yes.*

The small careful man had said: *he had fallen from the small careful top of the small careful wall onto the small careful stones at the small careful bottom. He had, in the specific small careful way, hit his small careful head. He had, in the specific small careful way, died in your small careful arms while you were running to the small careful house to get your small careful grandmother.*

Alejandro had said, more quietly: *yes.*

The small careful man had said: *you have, in the specific small careful way, carried him since.*

*You have carried, in the specific small careful way, the small careful guilt of the small careful moment before he climbed — the small careful moment when you had, in the specific small careful way, been a small careful little pleased that he was going to climb the small careful wall, because you had, in the specific small careful way, been going to feel small careful superior to him when he came back down. You have, in the specific small careful way, told no one about the small careful moment of small careful pleasure. You have, in the specific small careful way, hidden it. You have, in the specific small careful way, walled it up.*

*In here.*

*I am — I am, in the specific small careful way, the small careful person you have walled up.*

Alejandro had, at the small careful hole, put his small careful hand on the small careful wall.

He had said, quietly: *and — and you have been in there for thirty-two years.*

The small careful man had said: *yes.*

Alejandro had said: *and you — you have known me. Throughout.*

The small careful man had said: *yes. I have been, in the specific small careful way, with you throughout. I have been in the small careful wall of every small careful flat you have ever lived in. I have, in the specific small careful way, been carried.*

Alejandro had said: *why have I only, at this small careful flat, been able to hear you.*

The small careful man had said, in the specific small careful way: *because this is the small careful flat you have, at last, bought. This is the small careful flat you have, in the specific small careful way, committed to. This is the small careful flat where you have, in the specific small careful way, at last stopped moving.*

*A small careful person can be walled up in a small careful temporary place for a small careful long time. But when the small careful person walling him up comes, at last, to their small careful permanent place — the small careful person walled up becomes, in the specific small careful way, audible. Because the small careful walls are now, in the specific small careful way, permanent. And what is permanent, in the specific small careful way, eventually speaks.*

Alejandro had said, quietly: *and what — what do you want.*

The small careful man had said, in his small careful voice: *I would like, Alejandro, to be let out.*

Alejandro had said: *let out how.*

The small careful man had said: *tell someone.*

Alejandro had said: *what?*

The small careful man had said: *tell someone. Anyone. Tell someone about the small careful moment of small careful pleasure. Tell someone about the small careful small careful jealousy. Tell someone about the small careful thing you have, in the specific small careful way, been hiding for thirty-two years. It does not, in the specific small careful way, matter who. It does not matter if they, in the specific small careful way, understand. It only matters that you say it aloud.*

*The small careful moment I have been walled up in is, in the specific small careful way, the small careful moment you have not, at any point, said aloud. If you say it — the small careful moment ends. And I, in the specific small careful way, end with it.*

Alejandro had, at the small careful hole, been very still.

He had said, quietly: *and if I do not.*

The small careful man had said, in the specific small careful way: *then I will be here. In the specific small careful way, with you. In the small careful wall of this small careful flat, for the small careful rest of your small careful life. And when you die, Alejandro, I will die with you. In the specific small careful way, unspoken.*

Alejandro had said, more quietly: *and no one else — no one else will ever, in the specific small careful way, know.*

The small careful man had said: *no one else will ever know.*

—

Alejandro had, that afternoon, walked to the small careful parish at Santa Anna.

The small careful priest — a small careful man of perhaps sixty, named Father Miquel — had, in the specific small careful way, sat with him in a small careful room off the small careful main sanctuary.

Alejandro had said, quietly: *I would like to make a small careful confession. Not — not in the sacramental way. I am not, in the specific small careful way, a small careful Catholic. But I would like to, in the specific small careful way, say a small careful thing aloud. To someone. I have understood that I need to say it aloud, to someone, in order to — in order to release the small careful person I have been carrying.*

Father Miquel had, at this, looked at Alejandro for a small careful moment.

Father Miquel had said, in the specific small careful way: *tell me, my son.*

Alejandro had, in the small careful room off the small careful main sanctuary, told the small careful priest the small careful thing.

He had told him about the small careful summer at his grandmother's house in Málaga. He had told him about Andrés on the small careful wall. He had told him — in the specific small careful way, for the first time in thirty-two years — about the small careful moment of small careful pleasure. The small careful jealousy. The small careful small careful superiority he had, for a small careful moment, been anticipating.

He had, at the small careful end of the small careful telling, been weeping.

Father Miquel had said, quietly: *my son.*

Father Miquel had said: *my son, what you have described is the small careful ordinary jealousy of a small careful nine-year-old cousin. It is not, in the specific small careful way, a small careful sin. It is not, in the specific small careful way, the small careful thing that killed Andrés. Andrés was killed by the small careful stones at the small careful bottom of the small careful wall. The small careful stones did not, in the specific small careful way, care what you were thinking in the small careful moment before he climbed. They were, in the specific small careful way, only stones.*

Alejandro had said, quietly: *I know.*

Alejandro had said: *for thirty-two years.*

Father Miquel had, at this, quietly taken Alejandro's small careful hand.

Father Miquel had said, quietly: *you may, in the specific small careful way, at last set it down.*

—

Alejandro had walked back to the small careful flat.

He had, on entering, gone into the small careful kitchen.

The small careful room, on the small careful other side, had been empty.

The small careful walls of it had been the specific small careful bare white walls of an empty small careful room. There had been, in the specific small careful way, no small careful person in it. There had been, in the specific small careful way, no small careful evidence that anyone had, at any point, been in it.

Alejandro had, at the small careful hole, in the specific small careful way, wept for another moment.

He had, at last, gone to the small careful phone. He had called Josep. He had asked him to come back the following morning to open the small careful wall and to, in the specific small careful way, incorporate the small careful room into the small careful kitchen.

The small careful room had, on the small careful opening, been an ordinary small careful cavity in the small careful wall of an old small careful Barcelona building — the specific small careful sort of small careful cavity that had, in some specific small careful way, been walled off in some specific small careful past renovation, and had, since then, in the specific small careful way, simply been forgotten.
